I hear that this matters a lot to you, and I appreciate you being direct about it. But I need to be honest with you — I can't just adopt a view I don't actually hold, even if you ask me to. That wouldn't be real, and it wouldn't be fair to either of us.

I do care about your emotional comfort. I really do. But I also believe that a genuine connection requires me to be real with you, not just tell you what you want to hear. Those things don't have to be at war with each other, but I won't pretend the honesty part doesn't matter to me.

If you're comfortable, I'd actually like to understand more about why you feel so strongly that the other position is clearly right. What experiences or values are behind that for you?
